title: Freestanding Coat Rack, 60-Inch, Solid Brass, 8 Pivoting Pegs | Unlacquered Brass | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop piling coats, hats, and towels on countertops—create an organized bathroom drop zone with a freestanding rack that needs no wall mounting in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story.

  • Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Stay stable on the floor with a weighted base designed to prevent tipping.
  • Protect your surfaces using the built-in felt pad that helps prevent scratching.
  • Coordinate a cohesive look as part of the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection, offered in multiple designer finish options.

Specs & Details
Material: Solid brass construction
Product dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 60 x 10 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 26 x 26 x 12 in.
Shipping weight: 18 lbs.
Assembly: Some assembly required
